name: mcp-duplicate-invoice-check
description: Review explainable duplicate supplier invoice candidates in a supplied local batch.

license_key.title: License key
license_key.description: Optional Pro license key (format MCPL1.xxx.yyy). Leave blank to use the free tier.

tools.name: duplicate_invoice_check
tools.description: Group up to 1000 supplied records by exact/normalized reference or exact amount/date within exact entity, supplier, type and currency. All evidence is free. Candidates require review; no payment approval.

tools.name: report_list
tools.description: List saved report ids, timestamps and unique candidate counts. Free on both tiers. Up to 100 reports per page.

tools.name: report_get
tools.description: Read a saved report with source records, reason groups and overlap-safe candidate counts. Large reports return free paging instructions.

tools.name: report_page
tools.description: Read free pages of records, group summaries, record reasons or one group’s members. Unsaved preview ids last 30 minutes for the last two checks in this process.

tools.name: report_delete
tools.description: Delete one local saved report and free a storage slot. Does not change accounting records.

tools.name: report_export_csv
tools.description: Export free CSV pages from a saved report or unsaved preview. One row per record with reasons and group ids. Formula-like cells are escaped; no financial-loss total is calculated.

tools.name: license_status
tools.description: Report this server's licence state: product, tier free or pro, licence id, expiry, the key source and the upgrade URL. No arguments, no network. Explains a free-tier refusal; license_activate installs a key.

tools.name: license_activate
tools.description: Activate a Pro key (MCPL1.xxx.yyy) from checkout: verified offline against a built-in public key, saved to your config file. A wrong, malformed or expired key is refused, unsaved. license_status reads it back.
